metadata.description: P2S simulation: 1000 blocks, no stake, Ethereum mainnet gas, MEV attack strategies

blind_insert_p2s.description: Blind insert; after B1 can choose not to reveal (tx not processed, gas still paid)

attack_strategies_p2s_note: In P2S only blind insert is applicable. Front-run, sandwich, arbitrage are not applicable (B1 has only PHTs; cannot target). Blind insert: gas paid for PHT inclusion; if attacker does not reveal after B1, tx is not processed but gas is still paid (single gas fee).
